name: Planning
description: Date-driven news that affects planning at home and at work: federal tax deadlines and IRS extensions, Election Day, fiscal-year start dates, benefit payment schedules and other fixed dates set by government agencies. Each story states the date, the rule that sets it, what happens when the date falls on a weekend or holiday, and the official notice it comes from. Pieces link to the fiscal-year guide and the yearly printable calendar so readers can copy the dates onto a full-year plan and see them next to holidays and school breaks.
